# Feature: Shared Utils & Custom Hooks Layer

## Overview
Create `client/src/utils/` and `client/src/hooks/` and centralize duplicated logic that is currently copy-pasted across components and services. Today `client/src/services/api.js` repeats bare `fetch` + header + error-throw per method, `ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx:8-20` and `MultiSelect.jsx:27-39` duplicate click-outside handling, `KanbanBoard.jsx:15-19` defines `withProjectDetails` inline, `KanbanBoard.jsx:45-48` and `App.jsx`-adjacent code repeats `visibleTasks` filtering, and `TaskCard.jsx:46-55` owns a local `getPriorityBadgeClass`. Frontend scan must also cover `App.jsx:20-33` (`fetchProjects`), `ProjectsPage.jsx:13-22` (`fetchProjects`), `KanbanBoard.jsx:26-39` (`fetchTasks`), and `TaskModal.jsx:21-35` (projects+users fetch). This feature extracts a typed API client, constants, helpers, and at least two custom hooks so future features (offline queue, confirm dialog) reuse one canonical implementation.

## User Stories
- **As a developer**, I want a single API helper for all `fetch` calls so base URL, JSON headers, and error handling are consistent.
- **As a developer**, I want common UI behaviors (click-outside, data fetching with loading/error) as reusable hooks so components stay lean.
- **As a developer**, I want project/task helpers and constants in one place so filtering and badge logic are not duplicated.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
No visual components. This is a refactoring / code-organization feature:
- **`client/src/utils/apiClient.js`** — Core fetch wrapper: `export const apiRequest = async (path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {}) => { ... }`. Prepends `API_BASE_URL` (`http://127.0.0.1:8000/api`), injects `"Content-Type": "application/json"` when body exists, parses JSON on success, throws `ApiError` with `status` and `body` on `!response.ok`, handles `204 No Content` returns. Used by all service modules.
- **`client/src/utils/constants.js`** — Exports `API_BASE_URL`, `TASK_STATUSES` (`["TODO","IN_PROGRESS","REVIEW","DONE"]`), `TASK_PRIORITIES`, `STATUS_LABELS`, `COLUMNS` (migrated from `KanbanBoard.jsx:6-11` — array of `{ id, title, color }`), `PROJECT_FILTER_EMPTY_LABEL`.
- **`client/src/utils/taskHelpers.js`** — Exports `withProjectDetails(task, projectIds, projects)`, `getVisibleTasks(tasks, enabledProjectIds)`, `getPriorityBadgeClass(priority)` (migrated from `TaskCard.jsx:46-55`), `filterTasksByProject` alias. Each is pure and unit-testable.
- **`client/src/utils/helpers.js`** (optional barrel or merged into taskHelpers) — Generic helpers discovered in scan: `cn(...classes)` if className merging is ad-hoc, `truncate`, etc. Keep minimal; prefer adding only helpers with ≥2 call sites.
- **`client/src/hooks/useClickOutside.js`** — `export const useClickOutside = (ref, handler, enabled = true) => { useEffect(() => { if (!enabled) return; const fn = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) handler(e) }; document.addEventListener("mousedown", fn); return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", fn) }, [ref, handler, enabled]) }`. Replaces duplicated logic in `ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx:8-20` and `MultiSelect.jsx:27-39`.
- **`client/src/hooks/useApi.js`** — Generic fetch hook: `export const useApi = (fetcher, { immediate = true, initialData = null } = {}) => { const [data,setData]=useState(initialData); const [loading,setLoading]=useState(immediate); const [error,setError]=useState(""); const execute = useCallback(async (...args) => { setLoading(true); setError(""); try { const res = await fetcher(...args); setData(res); return res } catch(e){ setError(e.message || "Request failed"); throw e } finally{ setLoading(false) } }, [fetcher]); useEffect(()=>{ if(immediate) execute() }, [execute, immediate]); return { data, loading, error, execute, refetch: execute, setData } }`.
- **`client/src/hooks/useProjects.js`** (thin domain hook) — `export const useProjects = () => useApi(projectApi.getProjects, { initialData: [] })` or a bespoke hook that wraps `projectApi.getProjects` with retry support. Optionally `useTasks` sibling.
- **Refactored consumers** (same sprint, no behavioral change):
  - `client/src/services/api.js` rewritten to import `apiRequest` from `../utils/apiClient.js` and delegate: `getTasks: () => apiRequest("/tasks/")`, `createTask: (d) => apiRequest("/tasks/", { method:"POST", body:d })`, etc.
  - `client/src/components/ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx` — replace `handleClickOutside` + `useEffect` with `useClickOutside(dropdownRef, () => setIsOpen(false), isOpen)`.
  - `client/src/components/MultiSelect.jsx` — same `useClickOutside` adoption.
  - `client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx` — import `COLUMNS` from `utils/constants.js`, `getVisibleTasks`/`withProjectDetails` from `utils/taskHelpers.js`; remove inline `COLUMNS`, `withProjectDetails`, and inline filter.
  - `client/src/components/TaskCard.jsx` — import `getPriorityBadgeClass` from `utils/taskHelpers.js`; remove inline switch.

### Data Model (Mock)
No new entities. Reused models remain:
```js
// Task (from GET /api/tasks/)
{ id: 1, title: "Setup DRF", description: "...", status: "TODO", priority: "HIGH", assignee: 2, assignee_details: { id:2, username:"maya" }, project_ids: [1,3], projects: [{ id:1, name:"Backend" }], position: 0, created_at:"2026-08-29T...", updated_at:"2026-08-29T..." }
// Project
{ id: 1, name: "Backend", created_at:"...", updated_at:"..." }
// apiRequest error shape
{ message: "Failed to fetch tasks", status: 500, body: { detail: "..." } }
```

### Simulated Backend
No backend change. All HTTP still targets the existing Django endpoints (`/api/tasks/`, `/api/projects/`, `/api/users/`, `/api/tasks/{id}/reorder/`). `apiClient.js` must faithfully preserve current request/response contracts.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. **Scan & inventory**: Read every file under `client/src/`:
   - `services/api.js` (repeated fetch patterns)
   - `components/KanbanBoard.jsx` (COLUMNS, withProjectDetails, visibleTasks, fetchTasks, useFallback)
   - `components/TaskCard.jsx` (getPriorityBadgeClass, drag handlers)
   - `components/ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx` + `components/MultiSelect.jsx` (click-outside)
   - `components/ProjectManager.jsx`, `pages/ProjectsPage.jsx`, `App.jsx` (fetchProjects duplication)
   - `components/TaskModal.jsx` (parallel project/user fetch)
   - `context/ThemeContext.jsx` (already isolated — leave as-is or optionally extract `useLocalStorage` helper)
   - Document inventory in code comments or PR description; do not add dead abstractions.
2. **Create folders**: `client/src/utils/` and `client/src/hooks/` (both with `// Generated by Gemini ...` header on each new `.js` file, CRLF, tabs).
3. **Implement `client/src/utils/apiClient.js`**: Single `API_BASE_URL` constant, `apiRequest(path, options)` with JSON body handling, `Accept` header, `204` short-circuit, and structured error. Export `ApiError` class. Keep no semicolons, Biome-compliant.
4. **Implement `client/src/utils/constants.js`**: Move `COLUMNS` from KanbanBoard, define `TASK_STATUSES`, `PRIORITY_BADGE_MAP` if useful. Export named constants.
5. **Implement `client/src/utils/taskHelpers.js`**: Port `withProjectDetails`, `getVisibleTasks`, `getPriorityBadgeClass` as pure functions. Add JSDoc. Unit-level sanity: `getVisibleTasks([], []) -> []`, `getPriorityBadgeClass("HIGH") -> "badge-priority-high"`.
6. **Implement `client/src/hooks/useClickOutside.js`**: Accept `ref`, `handler` (`useCallback`-stable in caller), and `enabled`. Use `mousedown` (and optionally `touchstart`). Cleanup correctly.
7. **Implement `client/src/hooks/useApi.js`**: Generic fetcher hook with `data/loading/error/execute`. Use `useCallback` for `execute`; ensure `immediate` flag works for lazy fetches (e.g., modal). Handle stale-response guard via `ignore` flag if needed.
8. **(Optional) Implement `client/src/hooks/useProjects.js`**: Thin wrapper over `useApi(projectApi.getProjects)` to prove hook composition; or implement directly in App via `useApi`.
9. **Refactor `client/src/services/api.js`**: Replace each method body with `apiRequest(...)`. Preserve exported shapes `taskApi`, `projectApi`, `userApi` exactly so callers do not break. Remove try/catch that only rethrows after `console.warn` — let `apiClient` throw consistently and keep logging at the UI layer if desired.
10. **Refactor UI consumers**: Replace inline constants/helpers with imports; replace click-outside effects with `useClickOutside`. For incrementality, refactor at least 3 components: `KanbanBoard.jsx`, `TaskCard.jsx`, `ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx` (and ideally `MultiSelect.jsx`). Keep JSX structure and styling unchanged.
11. **Verify independence**: Feature must work standalone without ConfirmDialog or offline queue. Run `pnpm check`/`pnpm build`; manually test board load, drag, filter, task create, project create/delete. Confirm no visual regression.
12. **Cleanup**: Delete any now-unused local helpers; ensure barrel exports (if added) do not create circular deps (utils never import from components).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `client/src/utils/` exists with at least `apiClient.js`, `constants.js`, `taskHelpers.js` (headers, tabs, CRLF compliant) and each function is used by at least one consumer.
- [ ] `client/src/hooks/` exists with at least `useClickOutside.js` and `useApi.js` (headers, Biome-clean) and both are used in production code.
- [ ] `client/src/services/api.js` delegates to `apiClient.apiRequest` for all endpoints; base URL and error handling are centralized (no per-method `fetch` duplication).
- [ ] Duplicated code removed: `KanbanBoard.jsx` no longer defines `COLUMNS`, `withProjectDetails`, or inline `visibleTasks` filter; `TaskCard.jsx` no longer defines `getPriorityBadgeClass`; `ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx` and `MultiSelect.jsx` no longer define their own click-outside listeners.
- [ ] No behavioral regression: task list load, task create/edit/delete, drag-reorder, project create/delete/filter, assignee dropdown all work before and after.
- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` pass; grepping for `TODO: duplicate` or old helper names finds no leftover duplicates.
- [ ] Feature is self-contained and does not depend on ConfirmDialog or offline-queue runtime.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: None — independent of `feature-1-confirm-dialog` and `feature-3-offline-queue`. Can be developed in parallel; later features may import from `utils/hooks` but are not required for this feature to land.
- **External**: None. Pure React hooks + JS utils; no new npm packages.
